name: CupBack
description: Reusable-cup deposits: pay at one booth, get refunded in full at any authorized booth. Implements the CupDeposit covenant used by cupback.vercel.app.

resources.name: CupBack app
resources.description: The original CupBack web app (WizardConnect + CashScript) on Bitcoin Cash mainnet.

resources.name: Source code
resources.description: CupDeposit.cash covenant, app and this template.

guest.name: Guest
guest.description: Pays the cup deposit and receives the refund.

booth.name: Return booth
booth.description: Checks the returned cup, approves the refund and pays the network fee.

deposit.name: Pay cup deposit
deposit.description: Lock a refundable cup deposit in the CupDeposit covenant.

refund.name: Refund at booth
refund.description: A return booth approves the refund. The covenant forces the full deposit back to the guest; the booth pays the fee.

guest.name: Ask for refund
guest.description: Show the cup and this refund request at any booth.

booth.name: Approve refund
booth.description: Add one coin from the booth wallet to pay the fee, then sign.

recover.name: Self-refund after the event
recover.description: If no booth refunded the deposit, the guest takes it back after the recovery time.

refundTransaction.name: Cup deposit refunded
refundTransaction.description: Refunded the full $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshi deposit at a booth.

recoverTransaction.name: Cup deposit recovered
recoverTransaction.description: Recovered the full $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshi deposit after the event.

depositRefundInput.name: Cup deposit
depositRefundInput.description: The deposit held by the CupDeposit covenant.

depositRecoverInput.name: Cup deposit
depositRecoverInput.description: The deposit held by the CupDeposit covenant.

depositOutput.name: Cup deposit
depositOutput.description: $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshis held until the cup is returned.

refundOutput.name: Refund
refundOutput.description: The full $(<depositSatoshis>) satoshi deposit back to the guest.

cupDepositLockingScript.name: CupDeposit covenant
cupDepositLockingScript.description: Holds a cup deposit. It can only pay the full amount back to the guest.

receiptId.name: Receipt ID
receiptId.description: Random 16-byte receipt identifier. Makes each deposit a unique contract that can be refunded once.

recoveryTime.name: Self-refund time
recoveryTime.description: Unix time after which the guest can recover an unrefunded deposit.

guestLockingScript.name: Guest refund address
guestLockingScript.description: Where the refund is paid (the guest's P2PKH locking script).

boothLockingScript.name: Booth address
boothLockingScript.description: The return booth wallet that may approve refunds (its P2PKH locking script).

organizerLockingScript.name: Organizer address
organizerLockingScript.description: A second wallet that may approve refunds. Use the booth address if there is none.
